title: 人口双图｜分清实值与预测
prompt: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. The two line graphs show the total population and the percentages in three age groups in Latoa, a fictional country, from 2010 to 2050. Data for 2010 and 2020 are presented as reported figures; later values are projections. All country details, dates and values are editor-written practice data, not recalled exam data. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

data.caption: 据回忆主题自编练习图，非考场原图

source_status: 据回忆主题自编练习图，非考场原图。考生只记南太平洋某国人口与年龄结构的两折线，似有至2050的预测，国名、年份起点和数值均缺。本练习的Latoa为虚构国家；所有年份、人口和年龄比例均由编者设置。2010/2020列为练习中的已报数值，2020之后为预测，不是任何国家实际统计。[X18-01]
